Fine needles are inserted at certain points in the body to treat many types of health conditions and improve overall wellness. Acupuncture is based on the belief that energy (Qi) flows through the body in channels called meridians. An imbalance or blocked flow of this life force may lead to illness.

Fall into a deep state of relaxation with a chai infused eye pillow. Connect with earth energy in this deeply calming and grounding treatment.

items.name: Chakra Dhara
items.description: This treatment is based on ancient Indian holistic healing traditions. We start by awakening the skin by dry brushing the body. This improves circulation and removes impurities. Followed by an invigorating Ayurvedic style massage using a deeply nourishing warmed oil blend of Neroli, Rose, white musk with a hint of cinnamon.

items.name: Aura Harmony
items.description: This signature massage is a fusion of aura cleansing spray, chakra crystal layout, be lulled into a state of bliss with an aromatherapy body massage, drifting on the scent of lavender & bergamot working on both the physical and auric body you will feel an amazing lightness of being. We finish off your treatment with a singing bowl.

items.name: Nuad Boran
items.description: Originating from Buddhist monks this dry style massage combines stretching, gentle twisting and acupressure. No oil is applied and kimono is supplied. Finish off with a dry head and face massage while enjoying a lemongrass infused hot towel foot wrap.

items.name: Chi Reviver
items.description: This massage is a powerful energy reviver. Firm massage, kneading and pressure point techniques get deep into the muscles, relieving tension and improving the chi energy meridians. Eucalyptus, rosemary and lavender oils assist in the healing and rebalancing of the life force. Finished with a eucalyptus hot towel neck roll.

items.name: Reflexology
items.description: Begin with a refreshing lavender foot soak, followed by our signature pressure point foot massage from the knees down. This refined reflexology treatment helps restore balance, enhance circulation, and awaken the body’s natural healing energy, perfect for deep relaxation and revitalized legs.

items.name: Hot Stone Reflexology
items.description: Start with a refreshing lavender foot soak, lemon pandan foot scrub and peppermint green tea foot mask. Then enjoy an intensive foot and lower leg massage using acupressure on precise points on the feet to open meridians and enhance the bodies natural healing abilities. To bring balance to the treatment we finish with hot stone shoulder and neck massage.

items.name: Shirodhara
items.description: This Ayurvedic healing technique combines indian head massage include face, neck, shoulder massage completed by pouring warm coconut oil on the third eye area. This is the perfect treatment to completely quieten a busy mind having a soothing and balancing effect on brain cells while gently activating our intuition. Treatment 60 mins + 15 mins shower time.

items.name: Full Body Massage (Balinese)
items.description: Enjoy 70 minutes of massage, using blends of essential oils from Indonesian spices and flowers. Our massage therapists incorporate a variety of techniques to relax every day muscular tensions, aches and pains. A planet away from the Bali beach massage – end with a warm shower.

items.name: Exfoliation Massage (Mandi Lulur)
items.description: This treatment begins with a 65 minute Balinese massage, then the entire body is painted in a brown, granular paste (the traditional Javanese ‘lulur’) containing turmeric, sandalwood, cinnamon, and rice powder. The paste is then gently rubbed to exfoliate the skin. After a quick rinse, the body is covered in fresh yoghurt. The enzymes stimulate cell activity and restore the pH balance of the skin,

items.name: Aromatherapy Massage
items.description: During this treatment, the subtle aromas from the essential oils help strengthen the body’s healing potential and deepen relaxation. Choose from a variety carefully crafted premium quality blends to suit your personal needs (headache & migraine, PMS, cold & flu etc). This treatment includes an aromatherapy bath.

items.name: Magnesium Massage
items.description: A deeply restorative massage using high quality magnesium oil specifically formulated to enhance tissue recovery, ease muscle aches and inflammation, and improve tendon flexibility. Magnesium is a mineral that supports healthy muscle function, and is a favourite among those with physically active lifestyles. In order to allow the oil to have maximum benefit, we do not recommend a shower immediatel

items.name: Hot Stone Massage
items.description: Hot stone therapy is a powerful massage technique that involves heated riverbed stones. The effects of this ancient form of healing have been proven to release tension in muscles, increase blood circulation, trigger relaxation response in the nervous system and restore fluidity to the connective tissue joints. You will find it a wonderful alternative to your normal massage schedule.

items.name: Tension Release Massage
items.description: This massage combines Japanese Shiatsu palm pressing and pressure points along the energy meridian lines followed by a firm and deeply releasing oil massage to soothe sore and tired muscles.

items.name: Thai Massage
items.description: A Thai massage is more energizing and rigorous than other classic forms of massage. It is also known as the Thai Yoga massage, as the therapist will use her hands, knees, legs and feet to guide you into a series of yoga-like stretches.

items.name: Shiatsu Massage
items.description: A traditional Japanese finger pressure massage using slow, deep penetration of key points along the acupuncture meridians. The dispersing of excess or blocked energy can promote circulation to deficient areas of the body, stimulate the immune system and restore balance.

items.name: Pregnancy Massage
items.description: This is a very gentle massage using side-lying pregnancy massage techniques. For the first trimester, we suggest using our non-scented oil only. As for the second and third trimester, we have a pregnancy safe aromatherapy oil designed to calm and release muscle tension.

items.name: Slimming Massage
items.description: This treatment begins with a 20-minute full body anti-cellulite scrub enriched with green tea, ginkgo biloba, Japanese seaweed and bamboo micro beads. The scrub is buffed off the body with warm towels and a detox body mask and serum is applied. The body is then fully covered in sarongs to infuse while receiving a 10-minute scalp massage. The mask contains high antioxidant green tea extract and whi

items.name: DE NYUH BLISS
items.description: This blissful package is combination of Balinese traditional massage and body scrub or facial. Starting with foot wash ritual followed by Balinese traditional massage to relax your body. Completed with your choice of body scrub or facial to soften and brighten your skin.

items.name: MAXIMUM SENSATION
items.description: This maximum package is whole treatment in one package. Starting with foot wash ritual followed by Balinese traditional massage to relax your body, continue with your choice of body scrub, express facial to brighten your skin, end with body mask to soft and smooth your skin.

items.name: SET MENU
items.description: Customize your own package from our selection of starter, main and dessert.

items.name: FOOT MASSAGE
items.description: Relieve your tired foot with express foot therapy using friction and long strokes from sole to upper calf.

items.name: EXPRESS FACIAL
items.description: Pamper your self with our instant glow express facial that will bring back your youthful glow. Awaken your light and radiate your beauty.

items.name: BACK NECK AND SHOULDER
items.description: This massage is a fantastic cure for traveler's syndrome; stiff and sore neck and shoulders. The therapist focuses on the upper half of your body. Relieve stress and bring back relaxation after a long day of activities.

items.name: BALINESE MASSAGE
items.description: Experience the wonder of traditional Balinese technique that includes long, slow strokes. Kneading, and stretching and light acupressure stimulation.

items.name: REVITALIZE MASSAGE
items.description: Using muscle melting and deep pressure massage movements. Each treatment is customized to focus on your area of concern.

items.name: DE NYUH SIGNATURE FACIAL
items.description: This heavenly facial will make you feel like goddess with its natural recipe will leave your skin glow and fresh.

items.name: REFLEXOLOGY
items.description: Inspired by an ancient Chinese philosophy that the vital organs of the body are connected and mirrored to reflex points in the feet by energy channels called 'MERIDIENS' this deeply relaxing foot massage aims to unblock any latent energy and revitalize mind and body. Reflexology can improve health and is a blissful as it beneficial.

items.name: HOT STONE MASSAGE
items.description: We use heated stones to melt away your tensions. Therapeutic heat is slowly released into the belly of the muscle for a completely new body experience. The stones are pleased on key energy points. The combination of traditional massage and deep penetrating heat will balance the spirit and transport you the ultimate state of bliss.

items.name: ROSE PETAL SCRUB
items.description: The rose petal scrub consists of rice powder and fresh rose petals, and a nourishing oil blend which has an anti-aging benefits that will help to reduce fine lines, tighten and rehydrate skin. It will slow downs the visible signs of ageing, leaving skin firmer and perfect for sensitive skin.

items.name: KEMIRI & LEMON BASIL SCRUB
items.description: This fragrant scrub combines kemiri (candlenut) and lemon basil to revive mature and tired looking skin. Rich in vitamins with antioxidant and antl-bacterial mechanisms, it improves skin texture and tone.

items.name: COCONUT & SEA SALT SCRUB
items.description: Made of fresh coconut and coconut milk, this scrub also combined with sea salt. Good for removing dead skin cell and deep cleaning, leaving the body smooth and silky.

items.name: JAVANESE LULUR
items.description: This relieving exfoliation and body cleansing ritual which has been used in royal palaces of Central Java since 17th century helps to soften refine and deep cleanse the skin. This exfoliation treatment assists the detoxification process by sloughing away dry skin.

items.name: TRADITIONAL BALINESE BOREH
items.description: Made from several kinds of Balinese traditional herbs, this traditional Balinese blend will help to improve the blood circulation and detoxify your body and leaving a warm sensation lingering after the treatment.

items.name: SUNBURN & SENSITIVE SKIN WRAP
items.description: Feel the heat leave your sun burnt body with a blend of fresh cucumber, honey and yoghurt. The vast majority of wraps comprise moisturizing ingredients to hydrate, nourish and smoothen your skin.

items.name: NATURAL YOGURT MASK
items.description: Natural yogurt contains mild exfoliating properties to remove dead skin cells. Leave your body moisturized by the acid content from the yogurt. Perfect to softens and revitalizes the skin.

items.name: Signature Full Body Massage
items.description: Indulge in our signature massage, where traditional techniques, gentle stretches, and precise acupressure come together to restore balance, melt away tension, and rejuvenate your body and mind.

items.name: Balinese Full Body Massage
items.description: Experience the art of a traditional Balinese massage, combining rhythmic strokes, acupressure, and aromatic oils to soothe muscles, improve circulation, and restore harmony to your body and mind.

items.name: Hot Stone Full Body Massage
items.description: Immerse yourself in this ancestral massage style. Bali volcanic stones improve blood circulation, offer a sedative effect on pain, and promote deep relaxation.

items.name: Deep Tissue Full Body Massage
items.description: Relieve deep-seated tension with targeted strong pressure, promoting muscle recovery and reducing chronic pain for lasting comfort.

items.name: Release Back Massage
items.description: Relieve tension in your back and neck with this focused 30-minute massage, designed to target areas of stress, relax tight muscles, and restore comfort for a refreshed, rejuvenated feeling.

items.name: Expand Head and Shoulders Massage
items.description: Experience the incredible benefits of a head, neck, and shoulder massage. Improve circulation to ease headaches, neck tension, and shoulder discomfort.

items.name: Support Hands Massage
items.description: Soothe your tired hands with a gentle massage. This treatment targets pressure points and helps relieve joint strain, offering relaxation and comfort.

items.name: Rest Foot Massage
items.description: Give your feet and legs the care they deserve after travel or a day of exploration. This soothing treatment includes reflexology and extends up to the knees, releasing tension throughout your body and promoting deep relaxation and ultimate relief.

items.name: Wooden Massage
items.description: Awaken your body with this deeply stimulating wooden therapy, designed to drain, sculpt and revitalize.

items.name: Full Body Massage with Wooden Tools
items.description: This full-body experience uses the traditional wooden tools of madérothérapie to stimulate circulation, break down fat deposits and firm the skin. Perfect for reducing water retention and boosting lymphatic flow.

items.name: Arms, Back, and Stomach Massage
items.description: A targeted session focusing on the arms, back and stomach area. Ideal for those looking to tone and relieve muscular tension in the upper body.

items.name: Legs, Glutes, and Hips Massage
items.description: This lower-body treatment emphasizes legs, glutes and hips to drain toxins, reduce bloating and tone the skin.

items.name: Wooden Massage 10 Sessions

items.name: Relaxing Massage
items.description: Warm herbal oil is poured onto your body, followed by a soothing Ayurvedic-inspired massage to calm the nervous system and relieve deep stress, leaving you balanced, relaxed, and fully restored.

items.name: Balinese Massage
items.description: Experience Balinese massage techniques—pressure points, palm pressure, sliding, and kneading for deep relaxation. Release muscle tension, ease pain, and enjoy profound therapeutic benefits.

items.name: Exfoliation and Bath
items.description: Choose your scrub—lulur, milk, coffee, or green tea—to revitalize your skin. Finish your treatment by relaxing in a beautiful floral bath for a perfect, refreshing feeling.

items.name: Mandi Lulur – Floral Bath
items.description: Experience a 17th-century Javanese royal treatment with a 75-minute relaxing massage, a traditional full-body spice scrub, and a fragrant floral bath overlooking the jungle.

items.name: Mandi Susu – Milk Bath
items.description: Experience a timeless beauty ritual inspired by Cleopatra, with a 75-minute relaxing massage, a gentle milk scrub, and a fragrant floral bath for soft, smooth, and glowing skin.

items.name: Mandi Kopi – Coffee Bath
items.description: Enjoy an invigorating treatment with a 75-minute relaxing massage, a coffee scrub to smooth and tone the skin, and a fragrant floral bath for a refreshed, renewed feeling.

items.name: Mandi Teh Hijau – Green Tea Bath
items.description: A detoxifying treatment featuring a 75-minute relaxing massage, followed by a green tea scrub to rejuvenate the skin. Finish with a beautiful floral bath for a radiant and refreshed glow.

items.name: Mandi Rempah – Spice Bath
items.description: Experience a 75-minute relaxing massage, a warming spice scrub to improve circulation, and an aromatic herbal bath to soothe, restore, and renew your body.

items.name: Coconut Body Treatment
items.description: A deeply hydrating ritual combining a relaxing massage, a gentle coconut body scrub, and a fresh flower bath—ideal for dry and compromised skin.

items.name: Floral Bath Only
items.description: Immerse yourself in a fresh flower petal bath designed to rejuvenate the senses. Enjoy a quiet moment of relaxation for the body and mind.

items.name: Foot Spa
items.description: Treat your feet to a relaxing foot spa with a salt and lime soak, nail care, and a 25-minute massage for your feet and lower legs, leaving them refreshed, smooth, and well-groomed.

items.name: Gel Mask Facial
items.description: Our therapists gently cleanse and exfoliate your skin before applying a Bio-Aloe Vera mask that hydrates the skin and locks in moisture. The perfect soothing facial for normal to dry skin types, and those who have caught too much Bali sun.

items.name: Thermal Clay Facial
items.description: Specially crafted for oily or sensitive skin types, our Balinese clay facial is nature’s facelift! After the therapists gently cleanse and exfoliate your skin, a thermal clay mask is applied to your face and neck to purify and hydrate your skin, restoring its radiance.

items.name: Hair Cream Bath
items.description: Rejuvenate dull hair with an avocado cream scalp massage to stimulate circulation and promote growth, followed by a steam bath to lock in moisture for healthy, shiny hair.

items.name: Hibiscus Hair Shampoo
items.description: This centuries-old Indonesian ritual cleanses and nourishes your scalp with hibiscus extract to stimulate growth, prevent graying, and reveal lustrous hair.

items.name: Ayurvedic Facial
items.description: Our therapists gently cleanse and exfoliate your skin using a classic blend of antioxidant-rich herbs. A soothing Marma point massage calms you, before steam deeply purifies your pores. This facial revives skin texture, restores elasticity to prevent aging and gives you a radiant glow.

items.name: Yin Yoga
items.description: Designed to increase elasticity and mobility of connective tissues, Yin Yoga is a slow, gentle practice suitable for all levels as a complement to more dynamic asana-based ‘yang’ practices that emphasize lengthening and contracting of muscles. In Yin Yoga, seated and supine poses are held for long durations, usually between two to five minutes each, to penetrate through muscles and reach the ligam

items.name: Chakra Yoga
items.description: Each of our seven Chakra Yoga classes targets one of the key energy centres located along the spine to restore balance and harmony from the inside out.

items.name: AntiGravity Yoga
items.description: This dynamic “flying” practice combines athletic strength with the motion of dance in a session that lengthens the spine and improves flexibility. Bespoke Harrison AntiGravity hammocks have been designed to safely support bodies of all ages and abilities in enhanced and inverted postures not possible in other forms of yoga to maximize the benefits even from a single session.

items.name: Full Moon Yoga
items.description: Bathe in moonlight and harness the uplifting force of the universe. Balance the masculine energy of the sun with lunar vibe under the starry skies.

items.name: Restorative Hot Stone Yoga
items.description: Hot stones from the Ayung River are placed on the body as static, fully supported poses are held to further penetrate the muscles and melt away layers of tension. The mind is invited to focus on breathing, invoking a deep meditative state that strengthens immune, digestive and reproductive systems. This practice is available with sound therapy upon request, using pure quartz crystal singing bowls.

items.name: Power Yoga
items.description: A strong physical exercise starts by warming up the body with breathing exercises to a dynamic sun salutation combined with flow movement of yoga to increase metabolism, burn calories and contour the body.

items.name: Laughter Yoga
items.description: This unique exercise routine combines the freedom and health benefits of laughter with yogic breathing (pranayama) and asanas (poses): a simple and playful way to flood the body with oxygen and promote a natural sense of joy.

items.name: Hatha Yoga
items.description: This session begins with focused breathing exercises, followed by a warm up with the Surya Namaskara (sunrise or sunset salutation). It continues with yoga positions that support the body’s core strength and ends with relaxation poses. Complimentary for in-house guests (subject to change and fee applies when a visiting yoga practitioner is in residence).

items.name: Easy Yoga
items.description: Introduce yourself to the fundamentals of yoga through slow and soft postures and deep opening stretches that restore and reground. This practice is for beginners or those who seek a gentler class. Complimentary for in-house guests (subject to change and fee applies when a visiting yoga practitioner is in residence).

items.name: THE PROLOGUE
items.description: The story begins when the heavenly realms are attacked by the Great Giant Nilarudraka, who seeks to conquer the heavens. A great battle ensues between the gods and the giants, and the outcome cannot be undone. After a long battle, the gods are ultimately defeated by the Great Giant Nilarudraka.

items.name: THE PROPHECY
items.description: After the defeat, the god sought Bhagawan Wrespati to foresee the one who could defeat the giant. The prophecy revealed that the one destined to vanquish the giant was the son of Lord Shiva, who had an elephant head.

items.name: THE INTRUDER
items.description: It turns out that Lord Shiva is still meditating on Mount Kailasa, and no god or mortal dares to interrupt him. So, the gods send Lord Semara to provoke Lord Shiva. Lord Semara shoots Lord Shiva with the "Panah Asmara" (Arrow of Love), and the arrow strikes Lord Shiva's chest. Angered, Lord Shiva awakens, kills Lord Semara, and turns him into ashes, unaware of the truth.

items.name: THE SACRIFICE
items.description: The death of Lord Semara causes his wife, Lady Ratih, to mourn in sorrow. As a sign of her love and loyalty, Lady Ratih begs Lord Shiva to burn her as well, so she can share the same fate as her husband. Lord Shiva grants her wish.

items.name: THE TRUTH
items.description: As the arrow shot was the "Panah Asmara," Lord Shiva couldn't help but feel a longing for his wife, Lady Uma. They finally reunited to share their love. A few days later, while walking on Mount Kailasa, Lady Uma noticed a pile of ashes. She asked Lord Shiva about it, and after Lord Shiva explained, Lady Uma begged him to bring Lord Semara and Lady Ratih back to life.

items.name: THE FAITH
items.description: Finally, Lord Shiva granted his wife's wish on one condition: Lord Semara and Lady Ratih could not live in the heavenly realms. Instead, Lord Shiva spread their ashes into the "Mayapada Realms" (Mortal Realms), with the intention that all living souls would feel the sense of love within their souls, "Purusa & Predana."
